newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly up as yen dips.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly up as yen dips.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly firmer except for spot June on Thursday as the dollar jumped, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen per kg lower to 1.0 yen higher. Benchmark November was up 0.5 yen at 133.5 yen.
The market started mixed with most private investors sitting on the sidelines, but the yen's sharp fall in early afternoon triggered short-covering.
However, traders said sentiment remained bearish on weaker overseas markets. "Easing Thai rubber offer prices to Japan are seen as a bearish factor," one trader said.
